PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); this package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null), no hardware was attached or run, and no hardware or sim-engine run is claimed. The card's entry symbol pcgym.pcgym:make_env was confirmed at src/pcgym/pcgym.py:32 (class make_env(gym.Env)); the package serves the README quick-start CSTR configuration of that environment in simulated R0 mode. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue_requests and no site-limits.example.json (no operator-required bound).

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD (shape, not decision or helper): the card is family-config with GymnasiumDriver and that helper is kept, but the family's env_id path cannot construct pc-gym: the clone registers no Gymnasium id (no register() call anywhere in src/; the documented construction is env = pcgym.make_env(env_params), README.md:45) and make_env requires an env_params dictionary (src/pcgym/pcgym.py:33). The package therefore overrides make_bridge to pass the bridge an environment factory, pcgym.pcgym:make_env with the README quick-start env_params, instead of gymnasium.make(env_id); the class attributes and the derived cap.world.* contract are otherwise the family's. No gate run opened pc-gym and the sim backend was not run.

SERVED CONFIGURATION: the README quick start (README.md:23-45): model cstr, N=100 steps over tsim=25 s, so dt = tsim/N = 0.25 s and fidelity timestep_ms 250; a_space 295-302 K normalised to the Box(-1,1) action (one element), o_space [0.7,300,0.8]-[1,350,0.9] normalised to the Box(-1,1) observation (three elements [Ca,T,Ca_SP]); SP Ca 0.85 for 50 steps then 0.9. Normalise_a/normalise_o default True (src/pcgym/pcgym.py:61-62). Another model, plant, step count or observation bound would be a different configuration with a different contract.

NOT COVERED: the real pc-gym environment (not importable where the gate ran; it needs numpy, casadi, jax, equinox, diffrax, do-mpc and gymnasium, requirements.txt:1-9); upstream integration by casadi/jax (the fake uses one RK4 step with 0.01 s substeps per environment step, so trajectories and rewards were not compared with a real run); the other 18 models in src/pcgym/pcgym.py:146-166; constraints, disturbances, noise, parameter uncertainty, custom rewards and evaluation helpers; rendering (cap.world.render.v1 is not bound by the family bridge); snapshot/restore (make_env exposes no get_state/set_state). The fake returns Python floats and lists where upstream returns numpy arrays, and reset echoes the seed but the served configuration has no randomness, so the seed does not change the trajectory.

EXPECTED WARNINGS kept from the last gate run (all expected, none failed): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the pending seed for the next reset, so no native call is made) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer/numeric inputs seed (reset), seed (seed class), ticks and action.values[*]. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. test_driver.py keeps the required mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds eight cases (action-space envelope, normalised start state, CSTR step, N-1 termination and precondition, seeded reproducibility, seed class, published fidelity, e-stop latch); they pass. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
